```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# --- Libraries ---------------------------------------------------------------

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(1)
out_dir <- "C:/github/SNR_SDM/Results/age distribution and saturation"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Load and tidy data

```{r load}

pil_raw <- read_csv(
  "C:/github/SNR_SDM/Data/raw/Pilbara middens for calculations.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename(
    age_cal_bp  = `mean age Cal BP`,
    sample_name = Sample_Name
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_name = str_squish(as.character(sample_name)),
    age_cal_bp  = as.numeric(age_cal_bp),
    # Extract the rock shelter code and the "SNR" token
    shelter_id  = str_extract(sample_name, "^\\S+"),
    # Extract the midden token after "SNR" (e.g. "1A", "3B", "2")
    midden_tok  = str_match(sample_name, "\\bSNR\\s+(\\S+)")[, 2],
    # Pull out the leading digits (e.g. "1" from "1A")
    midden_num  = str_extract(midden_tok, "^\\d+"),
    # Midden ID = shelter + SNR + number (e.g. "PIL_2001 SNR 1")
    midden_id   = str_c(shelter_id, "SNR", midden_num, sep = " ")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(midden_id), !is.na(age_cal_bp))

# Sanity checks
pil_raw %>% slice_head(n = 12)
pil_raw %>% count(midden_id, sort = TRUE)

# Collapse to oldest age per midden (your chosen rule)
pil_midden <- pil_raw %>%
  group_by(midden_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_dates   = n(),
    oldest_bp = max(age_cal_bp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

list(
  n_rows = nrow(pil_raw),
  n_middens = nrow(pil_midden)
)

pil_midden %>% arrange(desc(oldest_bp)) %>% print(n = min(12, nrow(pil_midden)))


# Collapse to one value per midden: oldest dated age

pil_midden <- pil_raw %>%
group_by(midden_id) %>%
summarise(
n_dates     = n(),
oldest_bp   = max(age_cal_bp, na.rm = TRUE),
youngest_bp = min(age_cal_bp, na.rm = TRUE),
.groups = "drop"
)

ages <- pil_midden$oldest_bp
N <- length(ages)

# Sanity checks

list(
n_rows    = nrow(pil_raw),
n_middens = N
)

pil_midden %>% arrange(desc(oldest_bp)) %>% print(n = min(10, nrow(pil_midden)))
```

## Core plots

### Histogram + density

```{r hist_kde}


p_hist_kde <-
  ggplot(pil_midden, aes(x = oldest_bp)) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = after_stat(density)),
    bins = 12,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Oldest dated age per midden (Cal BP)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
   theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "grey90")
  )


# print to document
p_hist_kde

# save to file
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "Pilbara_hist_kde_oldest_age.png"),
  plot    = p_hist_kde,
  width   = 7,
  height  = 5,
  dpi     = 300
)


```

## Bootstrap uncertainty

```{r bootstrap_ci}
bootstrap_stat <- function(x, stat_fn, B = 5000) {
x <- x[is.finite(x)]
replicate(B, stat_fn(sample(x, size = length(x), replace = TRUE)))
}

boot_median <- bootstrap_stat(ages, median, B = 5000)
boot_max    <- bootstrap_stat(ages, max,    B = 5000)

median_ci <- quantile(boot_median, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
max_ci    <- quantile(boot_max,    c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))

list(
median_oldest_bp_ci = median_ci,
max_oldest_bp_ci    = max_ci
)
```

## Learning curves: “how many middens is enough?”

```{r learning_curves}
learning_curve <- function(x, stat_fn, n_min = 3, B = 2000) {
n_seq <- n_min:length(x)

map_dfr(n_seq, function(n) {
sims <- replicate(B, stat_fn(sample(x, size = n, replace = TRUE)))
tibble(
n = n,
est = mean(sims),
lo  = quantile(sims, 0.025),
hi  = quantile(sims, 0.975)
)
})
}

lc_median <- learning_curve(ages, median) %>% mutate(stat = "Median")
lc_max    <- learning_curve(ages, max)    %>% mutate(stat = "Max")

lc_all <- bind_rows(lc_median, lc_max)

p_lc <-
ggplot(lc_all, aes(x = n, y = est)) +
geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.2) +
geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
facet_wrap(~stat, scales = "free_y") +
labs(
x = "Number of dated middens",
y = "Bootstrap mean estimate (95% interval)"
) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p_lc
ggsave(
file.path(out_dir, "learning_curves_median_max.png"),
p_lc,
width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```


```{r}
# --- Text-only statistical summary: Pilbara -------------------------------

ages <- pil_midden$oldest_bp
n_middens <- length(ages)

cat("\nPILBARA MIDDENS – TEXT SUMMARY\n")
cat("--------------------------------\n")
cat("Number of middens:", n_middens, "\n\n")

cat("Oldest dated age per midden (Cal BP):\n")
cat("  Minimum:", min(ages), "\n")
cat("  Maximum:", max(ages), "\n")
cat("  Median :", median(ages), "\n")
cat("  IQR    :", IQR(ages), "\n\n")

# --- Bootstrap uncertainty -------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1)

B <- 5000
boot_median <- replicate(B, median(sample(ages, replace = TRUE)))
boot_max    <- replicate(B, max(sample(ages, replace = TRUE)))

median_ci <- quantile(boot_median, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
max_ci    <- quantile(boot_max,    c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))

cat("Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals:\n")
cat("  Median oldest age:\n")
cat("    2.5% :", round(median_ci[1]), "\n")
cat("    50%  :", round(median_ci[2]), "\n")
cat("    97.5%:", round(median_ci[3]), "\n\n")

cat("  Maximum oldest age:\n")
cat("    2.5% :", round(max_ci[1]), "\n")
cat("    50%  :", round(max_ci[2]), "\n")
cat("    97.5%:", round(max_ci[3]), "\n\n")

# --- Saturation / stability check ------------------------------------------

tolerance_bp <- 2000  # change if you want (e.g. 1000, 3000)
step <- 5

set.seed(2)

learning <- lapply(3:n_middens, function(n) {
  sims <- replicate(2000, median(sample(ages, size = n, replace = TRUE)))
  c(
    n = n,
    est = mean(sims),
    lo  = quantile(sims, 0.025),
    hi  = quantile(sims, 0.975)
  )
})

learning <- do.call(rbind, learning)
learning <- as.data.frame(learning)

learning$delta <- abs(learning$est - dplyr::lead(learning$est, step))

stable_n <- learning$n[learning$delta < tolerance_bp][1]

cat("Stability assessment (median oldest age):\n")
cat("  Tolerance:", tolerance_bp, "years\n")
cat("  Step size:", step, "additional middens\n")

if (!is.na(stable_n)) {
  cat("  Median estimate stabilises by ~",
      stable_n,
      "middens (changes <", tolerance_bp,
      "years thereafter)\n")
} else {
  cat("  Median estimate does NOT stabilise within tolerance across available middens\n")
}

```
